top_signals.title: South Africa Fund Manager Tips Nigerian Stocks Over South Korea
top_signals.summary: Allan Gray Ltd., which oversees $29 billion in assets, favors Nigerian stocks over South Korean equities, as they offer a diversification play from the artificial-intelligence frenzy that has swept markets from Wall Street to Asia.

top_signals.title: Ex-gang leader sentenced to 40 years to life in prison for Tupac Shakur murder
top_signals.summary: Until Duane "Keffe D" Davis' 2023 arrest, Tupac Shakur's murder had stood for nearly three decades as one of America's most notorious cold cases.
